tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Default page background and card fill. The site is white-first: most of every page sits on surface.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Warm off-white for alternating full-width sections. Never two paper sections back to back.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Pale navy tint for feature bands, the hero backdrop and highlighted cards. Use for air, not emphasis.

tokens.name: linen
tokens.usage: Warm fabric-toned tint for craft and materials content (leather, textiles, process). Use sparingly, one band per page at most.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and dividers on surface, paper and sky. Decorative only — never the sole signal for a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Form control borders on surface only (3.2:1). Do not place inputs on sky or linen; wrap them in a surface card instead.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body copy and headings on surface, paper, sky and linen (13.5:1 or better).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, meta lines on surface, paper, sky and linen (5.4:1 or better).

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: The brand navy, sampled from the logo. Primary buttons, links, nav active state, section headings that need weight, the focus ring. Text in navy reads on every light ground (10.8:1+).

tokens.name: navy-deep
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state for navy fills; footer background.

tokens.name: on-navy
tokens.usage: Text and icons on navy and navy-deep (12.5:1+).

tokens.name: needle
tokens.usage: The needle red, sampled from the logo. The accent: one key call-to-action per page, the eyebrow tick, active-link underline. Never body text, never large fills. Also marks form errors, always paired with words.

tokens.name: on-needle
tokens.usage: Text on needle fills (6.6:1).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Confirmation text and icons (form sent). Always paired with a word; reads on every light ground (5.5:1+).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Home hero headline only. One per page.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Leather, foam and plastics — restored and documented to the airframe.
styles.usage: The first paragraph under a hero or page title. Max 2–3 lines.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Every seat comes off, gets stripped to the frame and rebuilt with certified materials.
styles.usage: All running copy. Keep lines to the measure token.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Small uppercase label above h1/h2. Set in navy with a short needle tick before it.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button and nav-link labels. Sentence case.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Before and after: 1979 Baron, club seating.
styles.usage: Photo captions and legal lines, in ink-muted.

spacing.note: An airy 4px-based scale. Default to the larger step when in doubt.

tokens.name: space-2xs
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Gap between label and input; eyebrow to heading.

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons in a row.

tokens.name: space-md
tokens.usage: Paragraph spacing; small card padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-lg
tokens.usage: Grid gutter; heading to body copy.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-2xl
tokens.usage: Gap between a section heading block and its content.

tokens.name: space-3xl
tokens.usage: Section padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-4xl
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop — the default rhythm of the site.

tokens.name: space-5xl
tokens.usage: Hero top and bottom padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, small tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, image frames, feature bands.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills and status chips.

tokens.name: shadow-soft
tokens.usage: Resting cards on surface. Prefer a line border on paper and sky.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Card hover and the sticky header once scrolled.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Max width of page content.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max width of running text blocks.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Header bar height on desktop (64px on mobile).
